criteria.name: Completed assigned entries
criteria.description: Exactly 10 assigned vocabulary rows are required.

criteria.name: Accurate definitions
criteria.description: Each row explains the assigned technology word in student-friendly language.

criteria.name: Connected examples or visuals
criteria.description: Each row gives a concrete matching example or a clear visual description.
levels: All 10 examples or visual descriptions match.

criteria.name: Technology sentences
criteria.description: Each row uses the assigned word correctly in one complete technology sentence.
levels: All 10 sentences are complete and correct.

criteria.name: Readiness and responsible work
criteria.description: Four announced checks: own or assigned charged computer and school login ready; begins on time; uses files, measuring tools, devices, and materials responsibly; submits or returns evidence by the deadline. A forgotten or uncharged personal computer, unprepared login, lateness, or repeated responsibility reminders may lower only these 4 readiness points; academic criteria score the work itself. A documented school system, account, network, or hardware failure uses the equal fallback without deduction.
levels: All 4 checks are met, or an equal fallback is completed for a documented school-controlled failure.
No checks are met and no usable equal fallback is completed.

criteria.name: Assigned expo or make-up role
criteria.description: Four checks: role is identified; role is completed; student follows the speaking/demonstration/materials order; participation is safe and respectful.

criteria.name: Project explanation
criteria.description: Five school-expo checks: identifies what was created; explains the problem or need; explains how it works; states what was learned; explains how it can help make the world better.
levels: All 5 checks are clear and accurate.
Exactly 4 checks are clear and accurate.
Exactly 2-3 checks are clear and accurate.
Exactly 0-1 checks are clear and accurate.

criteria.name: Own contribution and project evidence
criteria.description: Three checks: explains own contribution; gives one real test or progress result; gives one supported improvement.
levels: All 3 checks are complete and supported.
Exactly 2 checks are complete and supported.
Exactly 1 check is complete and supported.
No check is complete and supported.
